newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iran raises Nov/Dec heavy crude formula - traders.
newsitem.headline: Iran raises Nov/Dec heavy crude formula - traders.

text.p: State-owned National Iranian Oil Co (NIOC) has raised its crude pricing formula for Iranian Heavy crude by 10 cents a barrel for November and December loading for Asian customers, traders said on Wednesday.
Following the hike, Iranian Heavy for November and December loading will be priced at Dubai quotations minus three cents per barrel, with an automatic adjustment factor subtracted from that.
Iran kept the price formula for Iranian Light unchanged at Oman's MPM minus 12 cents, with the automatic adjustment factor then added.
Iranian crude price formulas are set on a quarterly basis.
However, under a contract agreement, NIOC and customers can review prices whenever the market moves substantially.
In September, NIOC set the Iranian Heavy formula for the October-December term at Dubai quotations minus 13 cents with the automatic adjustment factor then subtracted.
Traders said the rise in the Iranian Heavy crude price formula reflected the pricing of similar Arabian Medium crude.
